title: Compute Engine: VMs, Disks, and Managed Instance Groups — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates VM hardware crash: demonstrates MIG auto-healing detecting consecutive health check probe timeouts, recreating the failed VM, and re-attaching persistent storage.
routing_rationale: The MIG auto-healing controller recreates instances in-place using the instance template, restoring zonal serving capacity within 120 seconds.

nodes.label: Crashed VM Instance
nodes.detail: Operating system kernel hung; stops responding to TCP port 8080.

nodes.label: MIG Auto-Healer
nodes.detail: Issues compute.instances.delete and recreates fresh instance from golden template.

nodes.label: Recreated VM Instance
nodes.detail: Successfully boots, mounts persistent disk, and resumes serving customer traffic.

steps.title: Failure Detection
steps.action: Health prober sends HTTP request; receives TCP reset due to kernel hang.
steps.why_traversal: Application-level health checks detect deadlocks that hypervisor pings miss.

steps.title: Auto-Healing Signal
steps.action: Prober signals MIG manager after 3 consecutive failures (15s total).
steps.why_traversal: Prevents premature restarts while avoiding extended customer outages.

steps.title: Instance Re-creation
steps.action: MIG auto-healer tears down corrupt VM and launches clean instance from image template.
steps.why_traversal: Restores immutable, verified software state in under 90 seconds.

steps.title: Service Restoration
steps.action: Recreated VM initializes and responds HTTP 200 OK; traffic resumes.
steps.why_traversal: Self-healing architecture restores SLA without manual operator intervention.

scenarios.label: Corrupt Disk Boot CrashLoop
scenarios.root_cause: Root filesystem corruption on persistent disk causes new VM to panic during boot.
scenarios.diverted_path: Recreated instance fails health check repeatedly; auto-healer throttles reboots.
scenarios.blast_radius: Capacity remains degraded by 1 instance until image is patched.
scenarios.recovery: Deploy stateless instances with OS on ephemeral disk and data on managed databases.
